WITH TMP_PDATE AS (

	SELECT  CAST(@Datetoprocess AS DATE) PROCESS_DATE
	
)

INSERT INTO EDS.DIGITAL_FIN_TXN_FACT
(
	 BANK_ID
	,EOM_DATE
	,TXN_DATE
	,CIF_ID
	,BILLER_ID
	,TXN_COUNT
	,TXN_STATUS
	,CRNCY_CODE
	,TXN_AMT_ORIG
	,TXN_AMT_PHP
	,TXN_TYPE
	,RECEIVING_BANK
	,GROSS_TXN_FEE
	,NET_TXN_FEE
	,GROSS_FEE_INCOME
	,NET_FEE_INCOME
	,SOURCE_CODE
	,INSERT_DTTM

)

SELECT 
	 BANK_ID
	,EOM_DATE
	,TXN_DATE
	,CIF_ID
	,BILLER_ID
	,TXN_COUNT
	,TXN_STATUS
	,CRNCY_CODE
	,TXN_AMT_ORIG
	,TXN_AMT_PHP
	,TXN_TYPE
	,RECEIVING_BANK
	,GROSS_TXN_FEE
	,NET_TXN_FEE
	,GROSS_FEE_INCOME
	,NET_FEE_INCOME
	,SOURCE_CODE
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM

(

	SELECT 
		 BANK_ID
		,EOM_DATE
		,TXN_DATE
		,CIF_ID
		,BILLER_ID
		,TXN_COUNT
		,TXN_STATUS
		,CRNCY_CODE
		,TXN_AMT_ORIG
		,TXN_AMT_PHP
		,TXN_TYPE
		,RECEIVING_BANK
		,GROSS_TXN_FEE
		,NET_TXN_FEE
		,SUM(TXN_COUNT * GROSS_TXN_FEE) AS GROSS_FEE_INCOME
		,SUM(TXN_COUNT * NET_TXN_FEE) AS NET_FEE_INCOME
		,SOURCE_CODE
	FROM 
	(
		SELECT 
			CTRAN.BNK_CODE AS BANK_ID,
			EOMONTH(CAST(CTRAN.TXN_DATE AS DATE))  AS EOM_DATE, 
			CAST(CTRAN.TXN_DATE AS DATE)  AS TXN_DATE, 
			CTRAN.CIF_NO AS CIF_ID, 
			CTRAN.BILLER_ID, 
			COUNT(CTRAN.TXN_ID) AS TXN_COUNT, 
			CTRAN.[STATUS] AS TXN_STATUS,
			CTRAN.FROM_ACCT_CCY AS CRNCY_CODE,	
			SUM(CTRAN.TXN_AMT) AS TXN_AMT_ORIG, 
			SUM(CTRAN.TXN_AMT_PHP) TXN_AMT_PHP,
			CTRAN.TXN_TYPE, 
			CTRAN.TO_BANK_NAME AS RECEIVING_BANK, 
			(CASE WHEN CTRAN.TO_BANK_NAME='CHINABANK SAVINGS' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(DBD2.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) END) AS GROSS_TXN_FEE,
			(CASE WHEN CTRAN.TO_BANK_NAME='CHINABANK SAVINGS' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(DBD2.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) END) AS NET_TXN_FEE,
			CTRAN.SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCE_CODE
		FROM (
						SELECT 
							CUST.CIF_NO, 
							MBKTRAN.BNK_CODE, 
							MBKTRAN.SOURCE_CODE, 
							MBKTRAN.TXN_DATE, 
							MBKTRAN.TXN_ID, 
							MBKTRAN.TXN_TYPE, 
							MBKTRAN.[STATUS], 
							MBKTRAN.BILLER_ID, 
							MBKTRAN.TO_BANK_NAME, 
							MBKTRAN.TXN_AMT, 
							MBKTRAN.TXN_AMT_PHP,
							MBKTRAN.FROM_ACCT_CCY
						FROM 
							(  
									SELECT 
										DISTINCT
										CIF_NO,
										CUST_ID
									FROM 
										EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB 
									WHERE 
										BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
							) CUST
							INNER JOIN	
							(
									SELECT 
									BNK_CODE,
									SOURCE_CODE,
									TXN_DATE, 
									TXN_ID, 
									TXN_TYPE, 
									[STATUS], 
									CUST_ID, 
									TXN_FIELD1 BILLER_ID, 
									FROM_ACCT_CCY, 
									TO_BANK_NAME, 
									TXN_AMT, 
									CASE WHEN FROM_ACCT_CCY <> 'PHP' THEN TXN_AMT *  ConversionRate ELSE TXN_AMT END  TXN_AMT_PHP
									FROM 
										EDS.MBK_RTBKTRANSACTIONMTB A
									INNER JOIN TMP_PDATE TP 
										ON CAST(A.TXN_DATE AS DATE) = TP.PROCESS_DATE
									LEFT JOIN 
									(    
										SELECT 
											DD.DateSk,
											CONVERT(varchar(12), CurrencyConversionTimestamp, 112) CurrencyConversionTimestamp, 
											ConvertFromCurrencyId, 
											ConversionRate 
										FROM 
											EDS.DATE_DIM DD
										LEFT JOIN
											BNKM.CurrencyConversion CC
											ON
											(CASE WHEN BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG ='N' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12),DD.Previous_Business_Day, 112) ELSE DD.DateSk END)=CONVERT(varchar(12), CurrencyConversionTimestamp, 112)

										WHERE 
											ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' 
											AND RateId = 'REV' 
											AND FinancialInstitutionId = 'CBC01'
									) RATE 
									ON RATE.DateSk = CONVERT(varchar(8), A.TXN_DATE, 112) 
									AND Rate.ConvertFromCurrencyId = A.FROM_ACCT_CCY

									WHERE 
										BNK_CODE = 'CBC01' 
						
							) MBKTRAN 
							ON CUST.CUST_ID = MBKTRAN.CUST_ID 
			) CTRAN
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
					CASE 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN EBK_BP 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN P2B_BP
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NULL THEN DEFAULT_FEE_BP
					END D_FEE
					,
					*
					FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM 
				  ) DBD1
			ON CTRAN.TXN_TYPE = DBD1.TXN_TYPE
			AND CTRAN.TXN_TYPE NOT IN ('BP', 'BPQ')
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
					CASE 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN EBK_BP 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN P2B_BP
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NULL THEN DEFAULT_FEE_BP
					END D_FEE
					,
					*
					FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM 
				  ) DBD2
			ON DBD2.BILLER_ID = CTRAN.BILLER_ID
			AND COALESCE(CTRAN.BILLER_ID,'') <> ''
			AND CTRAN.TXN_TYPE IN ('BP', 'BPQ')	
		--WHERE
			--CAST(CTRAN.[TXN_DATE] AS DATE) > '2024-12-31'
		GROUP BY 
			CTRAN.BNK_CODE,
			--DTE.CURRENT_MONTH_END AS TXN_DATE, 
			EOMONTH(CAST(CTRAN.TXN_DATE AS DATE)), 
			CAST(CTRAN.TXN_DATE AS DATE), 
			CTRAN.CIF_NO, 
			CTRAN.BILLER_ID, 
			CTRAN.[STATUS],
			CTRAN.FROM_ACCT_CCY,	
			CTRAN.TXN_TYPE, 
			CTRAN.TO_BANK_NAME, 
			(CASE WHEN CTRAN.TO_BANK_NAME='CHINABANK SAVINGS' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(DBD2.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) END),
			(CASE WHEN CTRAN.TO_BANK_NAME='CHINABANK SAVINGS' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(DBD2.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) END),
			CTRAN.SOURCE_CODE
			
	) TMP_MBK_AGG_TXN
	GROUP BY
		 BANK_ID
		,EOM_DATE
		,TXN_DATE
		,CIF_ID
		,BILLER_ID
		,TXN_COUNT
		,TXN_STATUS
		,CRNCY_CODE
		,TXN_AMT_ORIG
		,TXN_AMT_PHP
		,TXN_TYPE
		,RECEIVING_BANK
		,GROSS_TXN_FEE
		,NET_TXN_FEE
		,SOURCE_CODE



	UNION ALL


	SELECT 
		 BANK_ID
		,EOM_DATE
		,TXN_DATE
		,CIF_ID
		,BILLER_ID
		,TXN_COUNT
		,TXN_STATUS
		,CRNCY_CODE
		,TXN_AMT_ORIG
		,TXN_AMT_PHP
		,TXN_TYPE
		,RECEIVING_BANK
		,GROSS_TXN_FEE
		,NET_TXN_FEE
		,(TXN_COUNT * GROSS_TXN_FEE) AS GROSS_FEE_INCOME
		,(TXN_COUNT * NET_TXN_FEE) AS NET_FEE_INCOME
		,SOURCE_CODE
	FROM 
	( 
		SELECT  
			A.BANK_ID AS BANK_ID,
			--DTE.CURRENT_MONTH_END AS TXN_DATE,
			EOMONTH(CAST(A.TXN_DATE AS DATE))  AS EOM_DATE, 		
			CAST(A.TXN_DATE AS DATE)  AS TXN_DATE, 		
			B.CUST_ID AS CIF_ID,
			COALESCE(DBD2.BILLER_ID,DBD3.BILLER_ID,DBD1.BILLER_ID) AS BILLER_ID,
			COUNT(A.TXN_ID) AS TXN_COUNT,
			BB.TXN_ENTRY_STATUS AS TXN_STATUS,
			A.TXN_CRN AS CRNCY_CODE,
			SUM(A.TOTAL_TXN_AMT) AS TXN_AMT_ORIG,
			SUM(A.TOTAL_TXN_AMT_IN_HOMECRN) AS TXN_AMT_PHP,
			A.TXN_TYPE AS TXN_TYPE,
			D.BANK_IDENTIFIER AS RECEIVING_BANK, --NULL AS RECEIVING_BANK,
			(CASE WHEN D.BANK_IDENTIFIER IN ('0112','112') THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(DBD2.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD3.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD3.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) END)  AS GROSS_TXN_FEE,
			(CASE WHEN D.BANK_IDENTIFIER IN ('0112','112') THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(DBD2.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD3.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD3.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) END)  AS NET_TXN_FEE,
			A.SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCE_CODE
		FROM 
			EDS.RIB_TRANSACTIONHEADER A 
		INNER JOIN TMP_PDATE TP 
				ON CAST(A.TXN_DATE AS DATE) = TP.PROCESS_DATE
		INNER JOIN 
			(
				SELECT 
					ROW_NUMBER() over(PARTITION by TRIM(CORP_USER), BNK_CODE ORDER BY SCD_START_DATE) RN ,
					CUST_ID,
					TRIM(CORP_USER) CORP_USER,
					DEL_FLG,
					R_CRE_TIME,
					SCD_START_DATE,
					SCD_END_DATE,
					BNK_CODE 
				FROM 
					EDS.RIB_CORPORATEUSER
			) B 
			ON B.BNK_CODE = A.BNK_CODE 
			AND A.CORP_USER = B.CORP_USER 
			AND CAST(A.TXN_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN (CASE WHEN B.RN = 1 THEN B.R_CRE_TIME ELSE B.SCD_START_DATE END)  AND B.SCD_END_DATE
			LEFT JOIN 
				(   
					SELECT 
						DD.DateSk,
						CONVERT(varchar(12), CurrencyConversionTimestamp, 112) CurrencyConversionTimestamp, 
						ConvertFromCurrencyId, 
						ConversionRate 
					FROM 
						EDS.DATE_DIM DD
					LEFT JOIN
						BNKM.CurrencyConversion CC
						ON
						(CASE WHEN BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG ='N' THEN CONVERT(varchar(12),DD.Previous_Business_Day, 112) ELSE DD.DateSk END)=CONVERT(varchar(12), CurrencyConversionTimestamp, 112)

					WHERE 
						ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' 
						AND RateId = 'REV' 
						AND FinancialInstitutionId = 'CBC01'
				) RATE 
				ON RATE.DateSk = CONVERT(varchar(8), A.TXN_DATE, 112) 
				AND Rate.ConvertFromCurrencyId = A.TXN_CRN

		LEFT JOIN eds.RIB_TRANSACTIONDETAILS BB 
			ON BB.TXN_ID = A.TXN_ID 
			AND BB.TXN_ENTRY_STATUS = (CASE WHEN A.TXN_STATUS = 'PRO' THEN 'PEN' ELSE A.TXN_STATUS END) 
			AND BB.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
		LEFT JOIN  
			(
				SELECT 
					ROW_NUMBER() over(PARTITION by PAYEE_LIST_ID, BNK_CODE ORDER BY SCD_START_DATE) RN ,
					PAYEE_LIST_ID,
					BNF_ID,
					R_CRE_TIME,
					SCD_START_DATE,
					SCD_END_DATE,
					BNK_CODE 
				FROM 
					eds.RIB_CUSTOMERPAYEE
			) C 
		
			ON  CAST(C.PAYEE_LIST_ID as varchar(35)) = BB.CP_ENTITY_ID 
			AND C.BNK_CODE = BB.BNK_CODE
			AND CAST(A.TXN_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN (CASE WHEN C.RN = 1 THEN C.R_CRE_TIME ELSE C.SCD_START_DATE END)  AND C.SCD_END_DATE
		LEFT JOIN 
			(
				SELECT 
					ROW_NUMBER() over(PARTITION by BNF_ID, BNK_CODE ORDER BY SCD_START_DATE) RN ,
					BNF_ID,
					BNF_NAME,
					BANK_IDENTIFIER,
					R_CRE_TIME,
					SCD_START_DATE,
					SCD_END_DATE,
					BNK_CODE 
				FROM 
					eds.RIB_PAYEEMASTER
			) D 
			ON D.BNF_ID = C.BNF_ID 
			AND D.BNK_CODE = C.BNK_CODE 
			AND CAST(A.TXN_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN (CASE WHEN D.RN = 1 THEN D.R_CRE_TIME ELSE D.SCD_START_DATE END)  AND D.SCD_END_DATE	 
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
					CASE 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN EBK_BP 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN P2B_BP
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NULL THEN DEFAULT_FEE_BP
					END D_FEE
					,
					*
					FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM 
				  ) DBD1
			ON A.TXN_TYPE = DBD1.TXN_TYPE
			AND A.TXN_TYPE NOT IN ('BPR', 'QPT')

			
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
					CASE 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN EBK_BP 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN P2B_BP
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NULL THEN DEFAULT_FEE_BP
					END D_FEE
					,
					*
					FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM 
				  ) DBD2
			ON  BB.CP_ENTITY_EXTN1 = DBD2.BILLER_NAME
			AND A.TXN_TYPE IN ('BPR', 'QPT')	
			AND COALESCE(BB.CP_ENTITY_EXTN1,'') <> ''
			
			
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
					CASE 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN EBK_BP 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN P2B_BP
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NULL THEN DEFAULT_FEE_BP
					END D_FEE
					,
					*
					FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM 
				  ) DBD3
			ON  D.BNF_NAME = DBD3.BILLER_NAME
			AND A.TXN_TYPE IN ('BPR', 'QPT') 
			AND COALESCE(BB.CP_ENTITY_EXTN1,'') = ''
			
			
			
		WHERE 
			A.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01' 
			AND  LEFT(B.CUST_ID,1) = 'R' 
			AND A.DEL_FLG = 'N' 
			AND B.DEL_FLG = 'N'
		GROUP BY 
			A.BANK_ID,
			--DTE.CURRENT_MONTH_END, 
			EOMONTH(CAST(A.TXN_DATE AS DATE)),
			CAST(A.TXN_DATE AS DATE),
			B.CUST_ID,
			COALESCE(DBD2.BILLER_ID,DBD3.BILLER_ID,DBD1.BILLER_ID),
			BB.TXN_ENTRY_STATUS,
			A.TXN_CRN,
			A.TXN_TYPE,
			D.BANK_IDENTIFIER,
			(CASE WHEN D.BANK_IDENTIFIER IN ('0112','112') THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(DBD2.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD3.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD3.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) END),
			(CASE WHEN D.BANK_IDENTIFIER IN ('0112','112') THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(DBD2.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD3.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD3.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) END),
			A.SOURCE_CODE
		
	) TMP_RIB_AGG_TXN	


	UNION ALL


	SELECT 
		 BANK_ID
		,EOM_DATE
		,TXN_DATE
		,CIF_ID
		,BILLER_ID
		,TXN_COUNT
		,TXN_STATUS
		,CRNCY_CODE
		,TXN_AMT_ORIG
		,TXN_AMT_PHP
		,TXN_TYPE
		,RECEIVING_BANK
		,GROSS_TXN_FEE
		,NET_TXN_FEE
		,SUM(TXN_COUNT * GROSS_TXN_FEE) AS GROSS_FEE_INCOME
		,SUM(TXN_COUNT * NET_TXN_FEE) AS NET_FEE_INCOME
		,SOURCE_CODE
	FROM 
	(
		SELECT 
			'CBC01' AS BANK_ID,
			EOMONTH(CASE WHEN ISDATE(A.[Transaction Date])=1 THEN CAST(A.[Transaction Date] AS DATE) END)  AS EOM_DATE, 
			(CASE WHEN ISDATE(A.[Transaction Date])=1 THEN CAST(A.[Transaction Date] AS DATE) END)  AS TXN_DATE, 
			B.CIF_ID AS CIF_ID, 
			A.[Biller Mnemonic] AS BILLER_ID, 
			COUNT(*) AS TXN_COUNT, 
			A.[Status] AS TXN_STATUS,
			A.[Transaction Currency] AS CRNCY_CODE,	
			SUM(CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(REPLACE(A.[TRANSACTION AMOUNT],',',''))=1 THEN CAST(REPLACE(A.[TRANSACTION AMOUNT],',','') AS NUMERIC(15,4)) END) AS TXN_AMT_ORIG, 
			SUM(CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(REPLACE(A.[TRANSACTION AMOUNT],',',''))=1 THEN CAST(REPLACE(A.[TRANSACTION AMOUNT],',','') AS NUMERIC(15,4)) END) AS TXN_AMT_PHP,
			A.[Transaction Type] AS TXN_TYPE, 
			A.[Transferee Bank] AS RECEIVING_BANK, 
			(CASE WHEN A.[Transferee Bank]='China Bank Savings' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(DBD2.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) END) AS GROSS_TXN_FEE,
			(CASE WHEN A.[Transferee Bank]='China Bank Savings' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(DBD2.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) END) AS NET_TXN_FEE,
			'D30' AS SOURCE_CODE
		FROM 
			eds.d30_TransactionReport A
		INNER JOIN TMP_PDATE TP 
				ON (CASE WHEN ISDATE(A.[Transaction Date])=1 THEN CAST(A.[Transaction Date] AS DATE) END) = TP.PROCESS_DATE
		INNER JOIN 
			eds.d30_Customer B 
			ON B.USERNAME = A.UserName
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
					CASE 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN EBK_BP 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN P2B_BP
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NULL THEN DEFAULT_FEE_BP
					END D_FEE
					,
					*
					FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM 
				  ) DBD1
			ON A.[Transaction Type] = DBD1.TXN_TYPE 
			AND A.[Transaction Type] IN ('BillPay', 'Bills PaymentS (Enrolled)', 'Bills Payments (One time)', 'P2B (Enrolled)', 'P2B (One time)')--A.[Transaction Type] NOT IN ('BillPay')	
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
					CASE 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN EBK_BP 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN P2B_BP
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NULL THEN DEFAULT_FEE_BP
					END D_FEE
					,
					*
					FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM 
				  ) DBD2
			ON A.[Biller Mnemonic] = DBD2.BILLER_ID 
			AND A.[Transaction Type] IN ('BillPay', 'Bills PaymentS (Enrolled)', 'Bills Payments (One time)', 'P2B (Enrolled)', 'P2B (One time)')--A.[Transaction Type] IN ('BillPay')
		WHERE 
			[Transaction Category] = 'Financial'
			AND ISDATE(A.[Transaction Date])=1
			AND ISNUMERIC(REPLACE(A.[TRANSACTION AMOUNT],',',''))=1
		GROUP BY 
			EOMONTH(CASE WHEN ISDATE(A.[Transaction Date])=1 THEN CAST(A.[Transaction Date] AS DATE) END) ,
			(CASE WHEN ISDATE(A.[Transaction Date])=1 THEN CAST(A.[Transaction Date] AS DATE) END) ,
			B.CIF_ID, 
			A.[Biller Mnemonic], 
			A.[Status],
			A.[Transaction Currency],	
			A.[Transaction Type],
			A.[Transferee Bank], 
			(CASE WHEN A.[Transferee Bank]='China Bank Savings' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(DBD2.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) END),
			(CASE WHEN A.[Transferee Bank]='China Bank Savings' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(DBD2.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) END)
	) TMP_D30_AGG_TXN
	GROUP BY
		 BANK_ID
		,EOM_DATE
		,TXN_DATE
		,CIF_ID
		,BILLER_ID
		,TXN_COUNT
		,TXN_STATUS
		,CRNCY_CODE
		,TXN_AMT_ORIG
		,TXN_AMT_PHP
		,TXN_TYPE
		,RECEIVING_BANK
		,GROSS_TXN_FEE
		,NET_TXN_FEE
		,SOURCE_CODE
) SRC_FIN_TXN
DELETE FROM EDS.DIGITAL_FIN_TXN_FACT WHERE TXN_DATE = CAST(@Datetoprocess AS DATE);
